data: Which line represents the CNN+LSTM+SA+MLP model's accuracy?

The question asks which line represents the CNN+LSTM+SA+MLP model's accuracy. From the caption, we know that the bottom part of the figure investigates the effects of using different amounts of data when finetuning on Condition B. The legend indicates that the green line corresponds to 'Ours' (18K prog.), which includes CNN+LSTM+SA+MLP. Therefore, the green line represents the CNN+LSTM+SA+MLP model's accuracy.
